title: Following a Unique Path: A Fast Certifier Applied to Outlier-Robust Pose Registration
description:
arXiv:2609.03222v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Certifiable methods have arisen as a means to guarantee global optimality of solutions to non-convex problems using convex semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations. The most performant of these methods use a local solver to obtain the candidate solution, and then certify its optimality using efficient linear algebra techniques. However, for many problems of interest in robotics, this local-solve-then-certify approach is impeded by a form of dege
